summary: A Yes vote continues the city's existing 1% transactions and use (sales) tax for street infrastructure for eight years.

tax.text: A Yes vote would renew the existing one-cent-per-dollar sales tax for eight years to fund street and storm-drain improvements and related services.
tax.quote: Without increasing tax rates, shall the City of Monterey measure to fix streets, potholes, and sidewalks, repair storm drains to keep beaches/Monterey Bay clean, improve street safety and access for senior citizens, disabled residents, and others by renewing the existing one-cent per dollar sales tax for 8 years, providing $12 million annually

tax.text: A No vote would not renew the existing one-cent-per-dollar sales tax for the proposed eight years.
tax.quote: Without increasing tax rates, shall the City of Monterey measure to fix streets, potholes, and sidewalks, repair storm drains to keep beaches/Monterey Bay clean, improve street safety and access for senior citizens, disabled residents, and others by renewing the existing one-cent per dollar sales tax for 8 years, providing $12 million annually
